'''Star Tours Flight 727''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. On the morning of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]], it was stationed at Gate 1A, and its status was on time with an estimated time of arrival at 0835 hours. It was scheduled to depart again at 0930.
